$comment: Ported from GitHub Light High Contrast and GitHub Dark High Contrast, github.com/primer/github-vscode-theme (MIT, Copyright (c) 2020 Primer), as published in Shiki's bundled themes.
name: GitHub High Contrast
author: GitHub, ported for Switchboard

$comment: From github-light-high-contrast.json: canvas is editor.background, accent is focusBorder (the Primer accent).
code-bg is editor.background: the comments (#66707b) fall under AA on textCodeBlock.background (#acb6c033).
warn ("needs you") is Primer's pink #971368, from the theme's palette: the theme has no colour for that state, and its attention yellow would read as "working" here.
caution is gitDecoration.conflictingResourceForeground (Primer severe, orange); unread is the link blue.
High contrast: borders are panel.border on every surface, and the focus ring is focusBorder.
From github-dark-high-contrast.json: canvas is editor.background, accent is focusBorder (the Primer accent).
code-bg is textCodeBlock.background (#9ea7b366) drawn on the canvas.
warn ("needs you") is Primer's pink #ffadd4, from the theme's palette: the theme has no colour for that state, and its attention yellow would read as "working" here.
caution is gitDecoration.conflictingResourceForeground (Primer severe, orange); unread is the link blue.
High contrast: borders are panel.border on every surface, and the focus ring is focusBorder.
